name: MEAN WELL HDR-60 power supply
summary: Compact rail-mounted power-supply family with five listed output-voltage variants.
description: Place the supply beside the relevant DC distribution terminals while keeping input wiring and output wiring identifiable. Use the exact manufacturer model when checking rail space and terminal access.
The GA illustration is independently authored conceptual geometry, without dimensions or scale. Refer to the manufacturer STEP and selected product instructions for the actual mounting envelope.
readingNotes: The product page lists HDR-60-5, -12, -15, -24 and -48. The family STEP is a mechanical reference; choose the electrical order code separately.
A shared family model does not mean all output variants deliver the same current or power under every operating condition.
drawingChecklist: Record the complete output-voltage order code.
Check the selected CAD configuration, terminal access and rail attachment.
Apply manufacturer installation spacing and reserve cable bend and replacement space.
distinction: A shared family model does not mean all output variants deliver the same current or power under every operating condition.
